name: BibSonomy

sources.title: Signup page — loads behind a JS browser-verification challenge ('Verifying your browser')
Add bookmark form (search-indexed) — enter URL, then metadata; bookmarklet/add-on alternative
Registration confirmation (search-indexed) — activation email link must be clicked within 24 hours
BibSonomy blog — tags are a required field; posts can be public/private/friends/group visibility

conditions: Free account, but this is an academic social-bookmarking/publication-sharing system — a SaaS product page only fits as a bookmark post, which is marginal and can be seen as spam by the research community
Posts must be set to 'public' visibility to be indexable; tags are a required field
requirements: Registered account with email activation (activation link valid 24 hours)
Bookmark URL plus required tags describing it
Choose 'public' visibility — private/friends/group posts are not publicly visible
preparation: Product URL and a set of meaningful tags (tag recommenders suggest existing vocabulary)
Optional: a description/comment for the bookmark
workflow: Register at bibsonomy.org/signup and activate via the email link within 24h (site sits behind a JS browser check — use a real browser)
Go to /editBookmark, enter the product URL, then fill metadata and tags
The bookmark appears on your public user page and in tag listings
watchFor: JS anti-bot challenge on every page — automation will fail; use a browser
Academic community — pure marketing bookmarks are off-culture and may draw abuse flags
Bookmark value is weak SEO at best; the platform is for citation/bookmark sharing
countsAsLive: The bookmark is visible on the public BibSonomy user/tag pages (bibsonomy.org/user/<name> or tag listings)
unknowns: Whether outbound bookmark links are dofollow
